note: Manually curated hot-path D1 queries for the budget trip-wire (issue #1731). Each entry is a real query copied from app/lib, workers/, or a canary-backed endpoint, with callsPerDay as the estimated daily invocation count at current pre-launch scale. EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN runs each entry against the migrated schema; a plan regression (new SCAN, blown-up nested loop) or a callsPerDay bump that pushes the daily total over the trip threshold fails CI.

queries.name: session-by-token
queries.source: better-auth session lookup on every authenticated request
queries.sql: SELECT id, userId, expiresAt FROM session WHERE token = ? LIMIT 1

queries.name: user-by-email
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM user WHERE email = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1

queries.name: rate-limit-window-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rate_limit_events WHERE scope = ? AND key_hash = ? AND route = ? AND created_at >= ?

queries.name: rate-limit-claim
queries.sql: INSERT INTO rate_limit_events (id, scope, key_hash, route, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

queries.name: monitoring-due-orchestrated-runs
queries.sql: SELECT wr.id, wr.watchlist_id, wr.queue_priority, wr.queued_at, wr.started_at, w.user_id, up.plan FROM watchlist_run wr INNER JOIN watchlist w ON w.id = wr.watchlist_id LEFT JOIN user_plan up ON up.user_id = w.user_id WHERE wr.status = 'pending' AND wr.trigger_type = 'scheduled' AND wr.idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND (wr.retry_after IS NULL OR wr.retry_after <= ?) AND w.is_active = 1

queries.name: monitoring-reconcile-runs
queries.sql: SELECT id, watchlist_id, status, idempotency_key, workflow_instance_id, processing_token, attempt_count, queued_at, started_at, created_at FROM watchlist_run WHERE trigger_type = 'scheduled' AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND ((status = 'pending' AND (retry_after IS NULL OR retry_after <= ?)) OR (status = 'running' AND processing_started_at IS NOT NULL AND processing_started_at < ?)) ORDER BY queue_priority ASC, queued_at ASC, started_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT ?

queries.name: monitoring-first-scan-retry
queries.sql: SELECT id, watchlist_id, status, idempotency_key, workflow_instance_id, processing_token, attempt_count, queued_at, started_at, created_at, error_code, retry_after FROM watchlist_run WHERE trigger_type = 'manual' AND idempotency_key LIKE 'watchlist-run:first-scan:%' AND attempt_count < ? AND ((status = 'pending' AND (retry_after IS NULL OR retry_after <= ?)) OR (status = 'running' AND processing_started_at IS NOT NULL AND processing_started_at < ?) OR (status = 'failed' AND error_code IN ('browser_launch_failed','concurrency_limited','dispatch_rate_limited','first_scan_dispatch_failed','first_scan_setup_failed','rate_limited','retryable_scan_failure','workflow_binding_missing'))) ORDER BY queue_priority ASC, queued_at ASC, started_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT ?

queries.name: watchlist-list-for-user
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM watchlist WHERE user_id = ? AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?

queries.name: watchlist-active-scan-join
queries.source: app/lib/data/watchlists-core.server.ts active-watchlist sweep each monitoring tick
queries.sql: SELECT watchlist.id, watchlist.user_id, watchlist.name, up.plan FROM watchlist LEFT JOIN user_plan up ON up.user_id = watchlist.user_id WHERE watchlist.is_active = 1

queries.name: billing-webhook-claim
queries.sql: INSERT INTO dodo_webhook_event (event_id, event_type, user_id, received_at, payload_timestamp, outcome, processing_started_at, metadata_json) SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'processing', ?, '{}' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_webhook_event WHERE event_id = ?)

queries.name: billing-webhook-resolve
queries.sql: UPDATE dodo_webhook_event SET outcome = ?, processed_at = ?, processing_started_at = NULL, metadata_json = ? WHERE event_id = ? AND outcome = 'processing'

queries.name: meta-readiness-aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT provider, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) AS latest_success_at FROM discovery_fetch_log WHERE (provider = 'meta_library_browser' OR (provider = 'meta_api' AND json_extract(metadata_json, '$.customerOwned') = 1)) AND created_at >= ? GROUP BY provider

queries.name: digest-items-for-run
queries.sql: SELECT id, digest_run_id FROM digest_item WHERE digest_run_id = ?

queries.name: watch-event-recent
queries.sql: SELECT id, watchlist_id, event_type, created_at FROM watch_event WHERE watchlist_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?
